title: Stacked
tagline: Stacked allows avarage user to build their crypto portfolio with ease
description: Stacked is a normie friendly way to build out their wealth. It allows it’s users to design portfolio of assets they want to have and accumulate it over time without a need to deal with web3 wallet, decentralised exchanges and anything like that. Our users can setup an account with email or social login, topup their account directly from the bank account, and that’s it. Stacked will take care of purchasing crypto assets according to set target allocations in a semi automated way, guaranteeing that the users are getting the best price. No private keys, no wallet connnect, no transactionfees. Set it once, sit back and watch your portfolio growing.
how_its_made:
There are two technoligies at the core of Stacked:
1. Safe Account Abstraction SDK that allows user to create smart contract wallet using various credentials like email, social or existing crypto wallet.
2. CoW Swap enables finding the best price for desired crypto assets. More over, CoW swap covers the fees allowing gasless transactions.
Additionally, we have integrate Unlimit onramp sdk to make sure that user can topup their account from bank account or with credit card.
